command.acceptance: all three bank roles atomically acquired externally before/with acceptance; only idle executor accepts; capture fields and descriptors; hold cmd_ready low until prior response retires

response.identity: mask111/count3; original accepted identity, stable until response handshake; retain controller ownership identity until release accepted

local_memory.address_unit: 128-bit word index; byte selection/strobes local to executor
local_memory.read_request: rd_valid/rd_ready, bank_id4, word_address19, wide flag1; role-specific independent ports
local_memory.read_response: rd_resp_valid, rd_data256, tagged by in-order role acceptance FIFO; narrow data at low128 bits; no response-ready port
local_memory.credit_rule: reserve response FIFO space before request acceptance; must consume every returned beat even when compute/output stalls
local_memory.widths: A/B wide256 only for banks3,13,14,15 at even word address; banks8/9 narrow128; metadata reads consume selected valid lanes only
local_memory.read_bounds: aligned beat must stay inside allocated bank; selected tensor/scale bytes must be covered; unrelated alignment/padding bytes never become operands
local_memory.write: wr_valid/wr_ready, bank_id4, word_address19, data128, strb16; stable on stalls; update output coverage only on accepted writes

interface.completion: one matched response after all accepted read responses processed, arithmetic pipeline/results drained, final BF16 write accepted and coverage updates published; no further request for retired command; never signal done merely on last MAC
interface.descriptors: fabric supplies captured descriptor/profile, shape, position/layer, component byte-validity and scale locations; parent ISA validation rules precede memory access; no BANK_CONFIG or DDR control ports in this kernel

architecture.compute_style: N16 by K16 SIMD dot-product core, 256 products/cycle
architecture.memory_style: ISA-owned B3/B15 external-bank pingpong; internal K32 panel pingpong and staged A; no implicit DMA
architecture.sharing: one physical core and epilogue for all three opcodes; one in-flight collectively
architecture.scale_groups: M up to16 shared rows, N16 weight/features, full reduction K; preserve frozen dynamic/static scale policy
architecture.projection_schedule: for N16 subset of current ISA tile, loop K32 panels ascending; issue both K16 halves across M rows; accumulator persists across panels; output N start is ISA n_start+local N; m_start applies only input rows
architecture.QK_schedule: per KV head, preload associated3 query heads into up to96 logical rows (head-major); load Kcache token N16 by feature K32 panels and reuse across those rows; divide by sqrt64 via frozen FP32 scale sequence; process only causal valid outputs and explicitly write zero to all masked/padded score slots
architecture.PV_schedule: per KV head, preload3 query heads of P into up to96 logical rows, each full padded context; transpose V token K32 by feature N16 panels into B[N,K]; reuse across query heads; full context reduction with masked/tail P zero; per-V-feature16 scales
architecture.GQA_mapping: query head h uses KV head floor(h/3); no integer partial sums shared across distinct query heads
architecture.panels: one active and one filling internal B panel; local panel readiness includes byte validity and final accepted read response. Cannot overwrite active panel; no autonomous access to alternate ISA weight bank.
architecture.decode_limit: external/local bank feed and panel transposition can dominate decode; 256 products/cycle is staged compute capacity, not sustained end-to-end performance; GQA reuse amortizes K/V loads across three heads
architecture.epilogue_flow: 128 completed-vector FIFO absorbs last-K row bursts; four output lanes, stalls eventually stop core and new bank requests by credits; no arbitrary output stall may cause data loss

numeric.dot: exact INT32 across full K; no per-K scale or rounding
numeric.scale: FP32 positive finite prepared/dynamic values from bank sidecars
numeric.output: BF16 bitwise numeric_contract; separate four-lane epilogue child

buffers.name: A_staging
buffers.purpose: one full dense A or three GQA query heads; one256-bit local read per cycle; storage width256, depth3072

buffers.name: B_panels
buffers.purpose: two N16 by K32 INT8 panels, 16 channel partitions; each panel provides16 K operands per channel each cycle

buffers.name: partial_sums
buffers.purpose: 16 separately readable/writable channel partitions; exact row context

buffers.name: scale_metadata
buffers.purpose: selected/cached FP32 scales; not whole model scales

buffers.name: B_transpose_staging
buffers.purpose: PV gather/transposition staging before panel publication

memory.physical_note: logical payload capacity only; physical BRAM/URAM/LUTRAM packing, pipeline storage and metadata counters require synthesis; buffers are additional to frozen logical bank pool2224928B

resource_objective.hard_limits: no unmeasured per-module fit claim; report all resources and hierarchy; combined full-design resource fit remains board-stage work
resource_objective.OOC_objective: 5ns setup/hold/pulse-width pass, registered real256 product paths, demonstrated staged II1; use measured evidence before reducing lane count

control_rules.errors: shared error codes; illegal descriptors before memory access; numerical error invalidates destination on matched quiescent error; prior accepted tile writes may exist but must not be consumable
control_rules.recovery: stop new work and drain accepted reads/writes/results; report error only at quiescence; otherwise coordinated reset retains ownership; PS owns retry
control_rules.END: handled by dispatcher; kernel does not clear ready bank data on fragment END
